title: docs(spec,objectql): SharedRecordIds and fixed-read leaf seam docblocks describe the share arm after the switch
body:
Fixes #36121

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；只改了两处源码注释，让它们和第 6 步切换后的实际行为一致。
- 为什么做：属于「共享授权不再有 5000 条上限」那个系列的收尾，旧注释仍说名单最多 5000 条、仍说还没有生产者。
- 出错会怎样：只是注释，不改任何代码或行为；写错了也只是误导读注释的人，随时可撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

Comment-only, in two files. Each sentence below was false on `origin/main` (3aa008d436) after the ADR-0155 step-6 switch (plugin-sharing's `buildReadFilter` / `buildWriteFilter` now push `SharedRecordIds.read` / `.write` at `sharing-service.ts:828` and `:948`; `share-arm-boot.ts` holds the class-2 boot check; `shareGrantsInertReason` calls `driverEvaluatesFixedReadLeaf` at `sharing-service.ts:1763`).

`packages/spec/src/data/shared-record-ids.ts`

| line | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | It sits where today's list of granted ids sits | It sits where the share arm's list of granted ids sat before the producer's switch (ADR-0155 plan step 6) |
| 21-23 | The list the share arm binds today holds at most 5,000 members of G; the leaf is G at every count. | The list the share arm bound before the switch is retired; the share arm now carries this leaf, which is G at every count. |
| 72 | where today's `recipient_id` comes from | where the retired list's `recipient_id` came from |
| 102-104 | No caller of the comparand-shape door admits it until the engine's card (ADR-0155 plan step 2), and nothing writes it until that producer's switch (plan step 6). | The engine's callers of the comparand-shape door admit it (ADR-0155 plan step 2), and that producer writes it from its switch on (plan step 6). |

`packages/objectql/src/fixed-read-leaf-seam.ts`

| line | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 57-59 | the class-② boot check and R2's share-arm answer land with the producer (ADR-0155 plan step 6), and until then nothing on main writes the leaf. | the class-② boot check and R2's share-arm answer live with the producer, plugin-sharing (ADR-0155 plan step 6), which is the one writer of the leaf. |
| 85-86 | the seam's consult now, and the producer's up-front answer (R2) when it lands (ADR-0155 plan step 6) | the seam's consult, and the producer's up-front answer (R2, ADR-0155 plan step 6) |
| 121 | which today's read of the table runs and the subquery would read around | which the retired list's read of the table ran and the subquery would read around |

Kept, because still true at main: seam line 5, "`SharedRecordIds` today, ADR-0147's leaf on the card that adds it" (`FIXED_READ_LEAF_NAMES` is still `['SharedRecordIds']`), and "with no cap and no ordering" (ADR-0155 ① ruled A, restated unchanged). The corrected prose describes the 5,000 cap only as retired, never as live.

The card's `git grep -n "5,000\|5000" -- packages/spec/src/data packages/objectql/src` hits one grant-list line (shared-record-ids.ts:22, fixed here). The other hits are unrelated: autonumber seed page size (`engine-top-level.ts`, `engine-defaults-and-autonumbers.ts`), `MIN_MAX_EXCLUDED_ID_BUDGET`, timeouts and test fixtures. Left alone.

Two patch changesets, one per touched published package (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/objectql`), because the docblocks ship in the published bytes.

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so there is no new test and no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-arm-boot.ts:10` still says "today's grant read" about the retired list read. It is outside this card's file surface (not under the card's grep roots), so it is left for a later pass.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `git diff origin/main -- packages/spec/src/data/shared-record-ids.ts packages/objectql/src/fixed-read-leaf-seam.ts` shows only lines inside block comments, and `grep -n "today\|until" packages/spec/src/data/shared-record-ids.ts` no longer finds the list or the producer described as live.

Files to read first: `packages/spec/src/data/shared-record-ids.ts` (the 5,000 sentence, lines 21-23).
